Once you complete White and Yellow maps, your damage may seem to start dropping off.  Some things I learned through other players and personal experience.

- Swapping out ^x70FF70GMP^7 with ^x70FF70Greater Volley^7 feels better, both in damage and coverage of area for mapping
- Use Zealotry yourself, unless you have issues with constant death.  You may have to opt for some 6 portal gaming for a little bit while you save.
- ^xAF6025Dark Monarch^7 is the top priority item, and I recommend setting up an active search on the online POE trade website for one.  Some even get them cheaper than usual this way.
- Grab at least a few ^xAF6025Primordial Harmonies^7.
- Quality your gems, but prioritize your main ^xE05030Flame Golem^7 skill setup
- Make sure you have Unnerve and Fire Exposure on Hit on your gloves to make use of Discord on your ascendancy.
- You can get block capped if you opt for a shield with high block instead of life or minion damage like mine has + ^xAF6025Rumi's Concoction^7.
- You can also swap ^x7070FFZealotry^7 with ^x7070FFTempest Shield^7, but that is quite a large DPS drop.

The gear you see in this POB is what you saw in all of the video clips at the start of the video.  Everything was doable, but you will die on occassion and you should expect this is a league starter with some caveats.
Something that I found to be useful was^xAF6025 Maata's Teachings^7, as you can now corrupt this sceptre to have +1 fire skills.  This can be very handy replacing your ^xAF6025Clayshaper^7 if you don't mind losing 2 minions (assuming you have ^xAF6025Dark Monarch^7)

^xE05030^7Once you are ready to start working on the end game setup, start by getting these items:
- ^xAF6025Anima Stone^7 (+2 Golems with your helm)
- ^xAF6025Pledge of Hands^7 (the whole reason for this version of the build)
- 1 ^xAF6025Primordial Might^7 (for aggressive minions)
- More ^xAF6025Primordial Harmonies^7
- ^xAF6025Replica Dragonfang Amulet ^7with +3 Flame Golems
- ^x7070FFCongregation^7 minion support gem (Very expensive, but drops from Dread)


^xD02090**NOTE** The extra quality in the skill section is the result of matching colors of sockets.  Change this in accordance with your own socket colors.^7^7
